funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage of career; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication, with a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals seeking to disseminate research on British art through the publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering practical publishing costs such as image licensing, subventions, contributor fees and translation costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. Organisations can only apply for one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art, designed primarily to support staff costs towards facilitation of a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy (exhibition, digital project, catalogue or similar).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or non-profit; the exhibition on which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Supports the dissemination of research on British art by helping organisations produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis; items supported must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Helps protect and preserve significant works of British art by providing organisations funding to undertake original and needed conservation research, covering staff costs and equipment.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections (photographic, archival, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications or other assets relating to British art).
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support to organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel costs and equipment needed in the digitisation process.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Opportunity: Research Travel Bursaries

amount.raw: provides up to £250 to help cover transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a Member of ERBA (Emerging Researchers in British Art); membership pending is acceptable at application. Bursary to support a specific research trip (library, archive, collection, site, key contact, or event directly relating to research).
opportunities.summary: Micro-grant of up to £250 for ERBA Members to support a specific research-related trip, covering standard-class travel, mileage, local travel, accommodation and reasonable expenses, to be used between November 2026 and April 2027.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any stage of career for amounts up to £8,000; amounts £8,001-£20,000 available to individuals at postdoctoral level or equivalent. Open to international applicants. Applications from organisations on behalf of individuals not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research in British art, supporting research time (including backfill for those in employment) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives, plus some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctorate level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's level or doctoral degree who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country. Projects must focus on British works of art on paper from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries (prints, drawings, watercolours).
opportunities.summary: Grants from the Andrew Wyld Fund enabling students to undertake research trips to examine works on paper such as prints, drawings and watercolours firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin the course between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Provides full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art, bringing new perspectives to the understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years (or split over further years if required)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants who do not qualify for home fees may apply, but the amount is fixed at £32,000/year.
opportunities.summary: Provides full funding to support a doctorate in the field of British art, paying university fees with the remainder for living expenses, plus an extra £500 per year for networking. Part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives in British art studies.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at total of £35,000, or two years at total of £70,000 (paid at £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art that will reshape understanding of the field, part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: Provides a three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
